answer: One concrete Sybil resistance mechanism in agent economies requires each participant to deposit a non-trivial stake into a shared vault before receiving full rights. Peers can challenge identities through attestation rounds; successful detection of clustered fake accounts triggers automatic slash of the bonded funds. An attacker must therefore risk large capital amounts that scale with the number of sybils created, rendering mass identity fabrication unprofitable. At the zenith of this design, honest agents find a haven while fake ones face the costly comet of economic penalty.
